thread:
maria: Heads up — CVE-2026-3124 in fast-crypto-lib. Upstream fix is 1.3.2. We currently ship 1.3.0 in several Dedicated/Private images. Need triage + backport plan for customer-pinned/on-prem images (airgapped). :rotating_light:

alex: How exploitable is it? remote RCE or local?

maria: Remote parsing bug in the YAML/crypto handshake layer. PoC exists but requires specially crafted token metadata. Rated HIGH due to parsing vector.

kevin: Which images specifically? runtime names + tags pls.

maria: runtime: redwood-runtime:gpu-v2.1.0 (Hosted/Dedicated), onprem base image: rwinf-onprem:2025-11-04, and a couple customer-built images that vendor in our base: acme/redwood-prod:2025-10. Customers on Dedicated with pinned tags: AcmeCorp, BeaconHealth.

carla: Are any customers using customer-managed KMS that would be impacted by a rebuild/sign step? We need to coordinate key usage for image signing and registry pushes.

maria: Yes — BeaconHealth has BYOK for image signing (they use our signing pipeline but with their KMS alias). AcmeCorp is standard. For airgapped on-prem customers, we need to produce an offline image and sign with the customer's KMS or provide a signed tarball they can verify.

indra: Backport wise: upstream patch is small. We should create hotfix branch off each major customer branch instead of pushing to main release branch to avoid unexpected rollouts. Proposal: hotfix/fc-1.3.2-backport per release branch and customer branch when pinned.

alex: Agree. Minimal diff. Can we cherry-pick upstream commit?

kevin: Yes — workflow suggestion:

```
# from the release branch
git checkout -b hotfix/fc-1.3.2-backport release/v2.1
git fetch upstream && git cherry-pick <upstream-commit-hash>
# run our unit/integration targets for parsing and TLS
```

carla: For Dedicated customers we operate the registry and can push new tags, but for Private (VPC/on-prem) we need to produce per-customer images and follow their RR for signing. Who owns the per-customer build workflow? eng-platform or eng-infra?

kevin: eng-platform owns the build pipeline; eng-infra owns the registry access and offline image export process. I'll coordinate both.

maria: Two technical constraints: 1) some on-prem nodes are airgapped and only accept OCI tarball signed by their KMS. 2) our rollout tooling expects the image to have the same digest for canary comparison; for backports the digest will change — we need to emit an audit event that maps old->new image for customers.

security-bot: NOTE: Vulnerability CVE-2026-3124 added to tracking board (#vuln-triage). Severity: HIGH. SLA: 72h for Dedicated, 7 days for Private (customer agreement dependent).

maria: Proposed action items:
- create hotfix branches for release/v2.1 and onprem base (owner: kevin)
- build candidate images and run full regression (owner: eng-platform)
- arrange signing with customer KMS or provide signed tar (owner: carla + eng-infra)
- publish audit mapping and update RBAC for image-promotion jobs so only sec@/platform@ can push hotfix tags (owner: alex)
- notify affected customers and offer assisted airgap handoff (owner: cs/solutions)

alex: RBAC change detail: add a new role promoted-image-applier with least privileges: scope limited to registry:write for tags hotfix/* and audit:write. We'll add a short migration script.

maria: Also need to ensure our audit logging captures who triggered the backport, which branch/commit, and KMS key alias used. Event schema suggestion:

```
image.backport.event: {
  actor: "username",
  from_image: "rwinf-onprem:2025-11-04",
  to_image: "rwinf-onprem:2026-03-...",
  commit: "<sha>",
  customer: "BeaconHealth",
  kms_alias: "projects/redwood/keys/beacon-signing",
}
```

kevin: We'll add that to the build metadata and emit a signed S3 artifact for airgap transfers. eng-infra will run a quick verification step against the PoC patch to ensure lib version bumped to 1.3.2.

carla: Communication plan: notify AcmeCorp & BeaconHealth with ETA and mitigation steps. Provide timeline to BeaconHealth for KMS signing window.

indra: Prioritization: BeaconHealth = P0 (BYOK + public-facing ingest), AcmeCorp = P1. Others P2.

maria: Can we get a rough ETA? kevin?

kevin: If branch/ci runs clean: 24h for build + tests for Dedicated; 48-72h to produce signed artefacts and coordinate KMS for BeaconHealth. Airgapped handoffs may take additional time depending on customer's ops schedule.

deploy-bot: release created: hotfix/fc-1.3.2-backport -> build 2026-03-12T10:22Z, candidate tag: hotfix-fc-1.3.2-20260312

maria: Great. Last thing — any objections to backporting the minimal fix only (no other dependency bumps) to reduce blast radius?

carla: No objections. Keep change small and clearly documented in the release note and audit log.

alex: I'll open a short PR that includes RBAC migration script + CI gating for the hotfix tags.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the customer-facing note and ping CS. Keep this thread updated with build artifacts and S3 links for airgap deliverables. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Reminder: attach test results and CI logs to vuln-triage card when available.
